_comment: Domain parking services. A lookalike is parked when it shows nothing but one service: all its nameservers are the service's parking nameservers, or all its addresses are the service's parked-page addresses; and any mail host it has is the service's too. Parked lookalikes go on the block list, called out at lower severity than ones with their own mail or website. List only what serves parking and nothing else: not a registrar's default nameservers (they host live sites too), not forwarding or website-builder addresses (a forward can point at a phishing page), not hosting or mail real sites use.
_shared_comment: Nameservers a registrar or DNS host gives every customer by default: two domains sharing them have nothing else in common, so sharing them is no sign the same owner runs a lookalike.
